mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.title, a.content, a.type, CASE a.type WHEN 1 THEN '系统公告' WHEN 2 THEN '日常公告' WHEN 3 THEN '维护通知' WHEN 4 THEN '活动公告' ELSE '未知' END as typeName, a.priority, CASE a.priority WHEN 1 THEN '普通' WHEN 2 THEN '重要' WHEN 3 THEN '紧急' ELSE '未知' END as priorityName, a.is_top, a.is_popup, a.publish_time, a.expire_time, a.status, a.create_time FROM announcement a WHERE a.status = 1 AND (a.expire_time IS NULL OR a.expire_time > NOW()) AND a.type IN (2, 3, 4) -- 包含日常公告、维护通知、活动公告 ORDER BY a.is_top DESC, a.publish_time DESC, a.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.content, a.type, CASE a.type WHEN 1 THEN '系统公告' WHEN 2 THEN '日常公告' WHEN 3 THEN '维护通知' WHEN 4 THEN '活动公告' ELSE '未知' END as typeName, a.priority, CASE a.priority WHEN 1 THEN '普通' WHEN 2 THEN '重要' WHEN 3 THEN '紧急' ELSE '未知' END as priorityName, a.is_top, a.is_popup, a.publish_time, a.expire_time, a.status, a.create_time FROM announcement a WHERE a.status = 1 AND a.type = 1 AND a.is_popup = 1 AND (a.expire_time IS NULL OR a.expire_time > NOW()) ORDER BY a.publish_time DESC, a.create_time DESC LIMIT 1
